text:
Maya (PM): Quick thread — need to sequence the next set of model onboards. Candidates: Mistral-7B-C, Llama2-13B-int8, OPT-6B-quant. We need RICE-style prioritization + concrete launch criteria. ACME (EU) and FinCorp flagged asks. Thoughts?

Prashant (ML): Early perf datapoints: Mistral-7B-C ~120ms/token on A100-40GB (short ctx), Llama2-13B-int8 ~210ms with our int8 kernel path, OPT-6B-quant ~90ms. Mistral memory growth on long contexts looks risky.

Tom (Infra): FYI baseline GPU pool at ~85% until month end. Llama13B-int8 will need memory-tuning and kernel backports. If GA we should consider a Dedicated reserve or burst pool.

Emily (Eng-ML): We need an eval harness + smoke tests: semantic-sim, hallucination checks, prompt-sensitivity. Also validate streaming and function-calling for each variant if we promise it.

Liam (Sales): ACME wants Mistral in EU pilot. Compliance = private/EU-1 deployment. They're willing to commit to Dedicated if latency <200ms and cost < $0.6 / 1k tokens.

Jane (Customer Success): FinCorp prioritizes determinism + long-context behavior. Llama13B-int8 seems attractive but they want clear failure-mode docs.

Maya (PM): Proposed minimal sequencing: 1) OPT-6B-quant alpha (internal + 1 solutions customer) — low effort, quick win; 2) Mistral-7B-C pilot for ACME (EU) — medium effort (legal/ops gating); 3) Llama2-13B-int8 GA — higher infra/kernel effort.

Maya (PM): Quick RICE sketch (ballpark):
- OPT-6B-quant: Reach 4, Impact 3, Confidence 4, Effort 1 => RICE ~48
- Mistral-7B-C: Reach 5, Impact 4, Confidence 3, Effort 3 => RICE ~20
- Llama2-13B-int8: Reach 3, Impact 5, Confidence 2, Effort 4 => RICE ~3.75
(we're using Reach*Impact*Confidence / Effort, numbers are shorthand)

Prashant (ML): The Llama confidence might be 3 if we accept upstream int8 kernel availability. We should quantify quality delta on our eval suites (OpenBook + internal prompts).

Tom (Infra): For Llama13B GA: estimate infra effort = 2 sprint ops + kernel porting. I'll prototype a small burst pool for canaries. Canary policy suggestion: 5% traffic for 24h, monitor p95/p99 and error rate, then ramp.

Emily (Eng-ML): Launch criteria (proposal):
```
- perf: p95 latency < 250ms hosted (short ctx), throughput target met for typical batch sizes
- quality: regression < 1.5% on core eval set; no major increase in hallucination rate
- features: streaming + function-calling smoke pass
- infra: canary policy + auto-rollback on error/latency thresholds
- compliance: region controls for private deployments
- docs: SDK example + cost estimate
- support: SRE playbook + oncall handoff
```

Maya (PM): Also negotiate scope: propose we ship OPT-6B alpha with no function-calling initially (scope reduced). For Mistral pilot we'll enable function-calls only if ACME confirms requirements. Llama13B GA should include full feature parity.

deploy-bot: canary created -> pool=pilot-llama13b, traffic=5%

Tom (Infra): I'll provision pilot GPUs and add the canary autoscaler. Will also attach cost-estimate for burst usage.

Liam (Sales): I'll get ACME to sign a PO contingent on pilot metrics and confirm EU deployment constraints.

Jane (Customer Success): I'll schedule two pilot customer success sessions and collect representative prompts + failure cases.

Prashant (ML): Action: I'll run evals (OpenBook + FinCorp sample prompts) and share quality deltas by EOW.

Emily (Eng-ML): Action: I'll build the harness + a reproducible notebook for partners. ETA next week.

Maya (PM): Action owner summary: Prashant = evals, Emily = harness, Tom = infra pilots, Liam = customer PO, Jane = pilot onboard. We'll sync Thurs morning.

Maya (PM): Quick decision ask — can we start OPT-6B alpha this sprint and run Mistral pilot in parallel for ACME? If no blockers, we'll proceed.

Tom (Infra): +1 on OPT-6B alpha. Mistral pilot needs EU compliance OK from Legal but infra can stand it up.

Jane (Customer Success): +1 — prepping onboarding checklist.

Liam (Sales): +1 — will ping ACME this afternoon.

Prashant (ML): +1, starting eval runs now.

Maya (PM): Thanks all. Will file a short PRD and attach the gating checklist, RICE numbers, and rollout plan.

Emily (Eng-ML): :+1:

Maya (PM): tagging for visibility @devex @eng-runtime (for kernel/quant work)
